title: Free Time and Hobbies
introduction: Talk about activities you enjoy outside school.
definition: Talk about activities you enjoy outside school.
rules: Use play with many games and sports.
Use activity phrases such as ride a bike, read a book and go swimming.

vocabulary.description: hit a shuttlecock with a racket

examples.question: I ___ badminton after school. (play or read)
steps: Use play with the name of a sport.

examples.question: I ___ a bicycle. (ride or sing)
steps: A bicycle is a vehicle you ride.

exercises.question: I ___ badminton after school. (play or read)
exercises.solution: Use play with the name of a sport.

exercises.question: I ___ a bicycle. (ride or sing)
exercises.solution: A bicycle is a vehicle you ride.

exercises.question: What do you read: comics or football?
Complete: go ___ (swimming or swim)
exercises.solution: Use the -ing activity after go in this phrase.

exercises.question: What do you use to draw: a pencil or a ball?
exercises.solution: A pencil makes marks on paper.

exercises.question: Complete: I listen ___ music.
exercises.solution: Use listen to before naming the sound or music.

summary: Talk about activities you enjoy outside school. Use play with many games and sports.
